title: Paperless-ngx exit export, manifest.json
description: Exit export of the paperless add-on: the directory written by `manage.py document_exporter` of Paperless-ngx. This schema describes its manifest.json, a list of the exported database objects. Files named by the __exported_*__ keys lie next to it; metadata.json names the Paperless-ngx version. Restore with `manage.py document_importer` of the same version.

model.description: Application and model of the object, such as documents.document.

pk.description: Primary key of the object in the source installation.

fields.description: Field values of the object; references to other objects are primary keys.

^__exported_[a-z_]+__$.description: Path of a file of the object (original, archive version, thumbnail), relative to the export directory.
